dslRule:
<!id: util.replaceLocalGetClosestMonitor>
<!description: Replace calls to local getClosestMonitor with org.eclipse.jface.util.Util.getClosestMonitor for de-duplication. The local implementation is often a copy-pasted version of the canonical one.
Ensures the method arguments are of the expected types for semantic safety.>
<!severity: WARNING>
getClosestMonitor($display, $point) :: instanceof($display, "org.eclipse.swt.widgets.Display") && instanceof($point, "org.eclipse.swt.graphics.Point")
=> org.eclipse.jface.util.Util.getClosestMonitor($display, $point)
;;
